cycle.sh: Branch name as used in URLs, e.g.

eol.sh: End-of-life date, or true/false when the vendor gives no date, or null when unknown.

extended_support_until.sh: Paid extended support (ESU, ELS, Ubuntu Pro...).

has_versions.sh: False for products tracked by support dates only (no version numbers), so latest is always null.

label.sh: Display name when it differs, e.g.

status.sh: active: full support · security: security fixes only · eol: no fixes · current/older: products without support dates (GitHub releases).

status_label.sh: The vendor's own name for the phase.

support_until.sh: End of active support (then security fixes only).

ending.sh: Still supported, but support ends within 183 days.

message.sh: Plain-English explanation and what to do.

product.sh: Slug, or null when the line was not recognized.

info.description:
Free, no key, no sign-up. JSON responses allow any origin (CORS). Data refreshes every few hours; responses are cached for up to 10 minutes.

Fields that can be null are marked. In particular `latest` is null for products that publish support dates but no version numbers (`has_versions: false`), and for the rare product whose versions haven't been fetched yet.

Human-readable docs: https://latestat.com/api Non-JSON endpoints (/feed.xml, /{slug}/feed.xml, /{slug}/eol.ics, /{slug}.csv, /eol.ics, /eol.xml, /eol.csv, /products.csv, /stack/feed.xml, /stack.ics, /stack.csv, /badge/{slug}.svg, /badge/stack.svg) were removed on 2026-10-23: the SDK reads JSON.
info.summary: Latest versions and end-of-life dates for 528 software products.
